fields.name: ArgentSea
fields.responsibility: Holds the whole ArgentSea solution: a provider-neutral data-access core and the packages that bind it to a database platform or to an Orleans silo. They belong together because every package is a thin adapter over the same core abstractions — connection configuration, query definition, model mapping and shard addressing — and none of them re-implements those concerns.
